verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a programmatic API and publishes a changelog of API and CLI additions. However, no evidence shows API versioning, a version scheme, or a documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Having an API and a feature changelog is adjacent to this story and does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
